cast: Lily (girl, 9), her brother Tom (6), Mum, Dad, Grandma, Grandpa, Lily's classmate Mia, cousin Sam (10) and the puppy Max. Core words: Words and Screens.

words.en: Lily plays a game on her app.
words.sz: Lily 在她的应用上玩游戏。
words.scene: Lily holding a smartphone, looking at the screen with a happy expression, showing a colorful simple game interface.

words.en: Sam writes a blog about football.
words.sz: Sam 写一个关于足球的博客。
words.scene: Sam sitting at a desk typing on a laptop, a picture of a football goal on the screen.
more: Mia reads my new blog post.
Mia 读我新的博客文章。
I write in my blog every week.

words.scene: A TV screen showing a football match, Dad sitting on the sofa watching it.
A laptop screen showing a simple chat interface with speech bubbles, Mia typing on the keyboard.
more: 加入我们的班级聊天室。

words.scene: Lily talking on the phone with a happy face, sitting on the stairs.
more: Dad contacts his office by email.
爸爸通过电子邮件联系他的办公室。

words.scene: Lily at a laptop pointing at a picture of a puppy on the screen, a small hand-shaped mouse pointer on the picture, a click sound shown by little lines, no writing on the screen.
Dad sitting at a desk with two monitors showing lines of code (abstract colorful blocks, no text), looking focused.
more: This app is a good program.

words.sz: 凯特阿姨使用社交媒体。
words.scene: A woman (Kate) holding a phone, taking a selfie in front of a cafe window, smiling.
more: Don't share photos on social media.
不要在社交媒体上分享照片。
My friends use social media too.
我的朋友们也用社交媒体。

words.scene: A classroom with a whiteboard and tablets, children using digital tools happily.

words.en: Send a text message to Sam.
words.sz: 给 Sam 发一条短信。
words.scene: A hand holding a phone, typing on the keyboard, a speech bubble popping up from the screen.
more: I got a funny text message.
我收到一条有趣的短信。

words.scene: A computer screen showing a progress bar filling up, with an arrow pointing up towards a cloud icon.
more: Wait for the upload to finish.

words.sz: 这里的无线网工作得很好。
words.scene: A small black router with antennas on a shelf, showing three bright green bars indicating full strength.
Lily writing in a notebook with a pencil, looking at the page with focus.
Tom pointing at a word on a worksheet, Mum looking over his shoulder helping him.
Lily sitting with a pile of picture cards and a dictionary, looking determined.
Max the puppy sitting next to a stack of books, looking up at Lily who is holding a flashcard.

more: 我喜欢这部电影的标题。

words.scene: Lily and Mia talking in a classroom, pointing at a poster on the wall showing various animals (lions, monkeys).

more: Can you give me an example?
Tom 学习关于动物的事实。
Here is a fact: a spider has eight legs.
告诉你一个事实：蜘蛛有八条腿。

words.sz: Lily 得到了一个好分数。
more: 爸爸检查我的数学分数。

words.scene: Tom at his desk with a pencil, looking down unhappily at his exercise book where one big red cross is drawn next to a row of sums; no readable writing; he is not smiling.
more: It's OK to make a mistake.
Mum finds a mistake in the list.
妈妈在清单里发现了一个错误。
Mum explains the details to Dad.

words.scene: Dad at his office desk in a white shirt, holding a few sheets of printed paper close and reading carefully, a computer and a folder beside him; the lines on the paper are grey and unreadable.
more: 妈妈在重要的文件上签字。

words.sz: 妈妈写了一张购物清单。
words.scene: Mum in the kitchen holding a short paper shopping list in one hand and a pen in the other, ticking something off, an open fridge behind her; the list shows tiny pictures of milk, eggs and apples instead of words.
more: I have a long list of names.

words.scene: An open book with the left and right pages visible, a finger pointing to the middle of one page.
more: The first page has a picture.

words.scene: A red octagonal road sign with a white border standing next to a grassy path, no text inside.
more: 爷爷修好了花园的牌子。

words.en: Mum reads a story at night.
words.scene: Mum sitting on the edge of Tom's bed holding an open book, Tom tucked in with Max sleeping at the foot of the bed.
more: Lily 写了一个有趣的故事。

words.scene: Lily at a desk carefully writing in an exercise book with a pencil, her tongue out in concentration, neat grey wavy lines on the page.

more: Dad writes a review of the film.
爸爸写了一篇电影评论。
We need to review this part.
What's the difference between these two?
Can you find the difference in these pictures?
你能找出这两幅图的不同吗？

words.scene: A ceramic piggy bank on a table, coins falling into the slot from Mum's hand.
A small pile of copper coins on a shop counter next to a bar of chocolate, no faces visible.

more: Mum has trouble opening the box.
妈妈打不开盒子，有点麻烦。
Don't get into trouble at school.

words.scene: Lily standing on a step stool washing vegetables in the sink while Mum stirs a pot nearby.

words.sz: Lily 看一个有趣的广告。
words.scene: A television screen showing a bright cartoon character holding a box of cereal, Lily watching from the sofa.
more: Dad reads an advert in the paper.
爸爸在报纸上读了一则广告。
The new advert is on the radio.

words.en: Look at the notice on the wall.
words.scene: Children in a school corridor looking up at a big paper sheet pinned to a noticeboard; the sheet shows a picture of a football and a sun, no words.
more: There is a new notice in the office.
办公室里有一张新通知。
